ITEM 1 | Several strips of cooked bacon, reddish-brown with darker crispy edges and glossy rendered sheen, lying in an overlapping stack across the upper-center of the plate, roughly 14 cm long and 8 cm wide total footprint, about 1 cm thick at the stack | 45
ITEM 2 | Scrambled eggs, pale yellow with some deeper yellow curds, soft, moist-looking, clumped and folded in irregular piles on the right side of the plate, covering roughly 15% of the plate area, about 2 cm high | 85
ITEM 3 | Diced sweet potato cubes, orange with browned caramelized edges and slightly glossy surfaces, roughly 1.5 cm pieces, clustered in the lower-center of the plate beside the eggs, about 1.5 cm high | 60
ITEM 4 | Fresh strawberries, bright red, halved and sliced, with white cores visible, one large half-slice about 5 cm long and two smaller slices about 2.5 cm across, on the left lower side of the plate | 35
ITEM 5 | Small chunks of browned meat, likely pork, reddish-brown with a seared outer crust, about 1.5 cm pieces, mixed among the sweet potato at the bottom of the plate | 15
ITEM 6 | A few small dark blueberries, deep blue-purple and matte with slight sheen, about 1 cm each, near the bottom center of the plate | 3
